review.intent_summary: Callers can apply a different explicit action policy to existing assessments and cases without recomputing numerical analysis.

criteria.criterion: Default policy leaves action and notification eligibility disabled.
Explicit-rule and calibrated-departure eligibility are controlled independently.
Notification eligibility can be allowed for a met criterion without action eligibility, while early candidates remain ineligible.
Replaying policy preserves numerical evidence and stable case IDs, records changed case revisions, and leaves the original result unchanged.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Compared unit-cost default versus allow_explicit_rules policy: action eligibility false/true, with identical relationship lineage and numerical violation.
